parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPN gateway instance.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query the region ID.

parameters.name: RouteEntryType
parameters.description:
The type of the route entry. Valid values:

- **custom** (default): queries the destination routes of the VPN gateway instance.
- **bgp**: queries the BGP routes of the VPN gateway instance.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPN gateway.
